title: Warm-path tracker (campaign/warm-paths.json)
description: How far each contact at a target organisation has come, on one ladder: followed, talked, connected, knows_your_work, would_refer. Progress only: score.py never reads this file, so it changes no score. The warm path factor (D3) is judged from evidence in profile/evidence.json. Names stay in the workspace and are hidden on the dashboard and in the agent files unless the person opts in.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads. Kept as is.

stage.description: followed: you follow their work and they may not know you yet (a LinkedIn connection you have never spoken with is here too). talked: a real exchange, such as a reply, a call or a chat at an event. connected: a two-way line, they would recognise your name and reply. knows_your_work: they have seen something you made or did. would_refer: they have said they would refer you, or introduce you to the hiring manager.

person.description: Their name, as the person knows them. Private.

role.description: Their job title or team, if known.

updated_on.description: When the stage last changed or was last checked.

next_step.description: The next small, honest step with this person, in plain words.

action.description: The plan action this next step belongs to, if any (an id from campaign/plan.json).

evidence.description: Evidence ids that show the stage, such as their email agreeing to refer. Optional, and it never changes a score here.

history.description: The stages so far, oldest first. The last entry matches stage.
